banner.title: Enable SmartFormly on your storefront
banner.body: Activate the SmartFormly app embed in your theme editor to start showing forms on your storefront. Click the button to open the theme editor — then toggle SmartFormly on and save.

createForm.title: Create a form
createForm.body: Build and customize forms to collect the information you need.

enableStorefront.title: Enable on storefront
enableStorefront.body: Toggle the SmartFormly embed in your theme editor to show forms on your store.

learnMore.title: Learn more
learnMore.body: Guides, tips and answers to help you get the most from SmartFormly.

hero.title: Turn questions
hero.sub: Create beautiful forms, collect valuable information and grow your Shopify store.
